title: LLMs Model Non-WEIRD Populations (SCA)
one_line_claim: LLM synthetic cultural agents can qualitatively track non-WEIRD experimental behavior where human data exist.
notes: Primary SCA paper; anchor asset for WEIRD-bias and synthetic-participant threads.

title: cvprofiles — construct-validity measurement layer
one_line_claim: Whether a measure validly captures its construct depends on which version of the measure is used, and finding that no version passes is itself a result.
notes: Methods/package asset for Big Five, LLM measurement, and policy-proxy validity discussions.
caveat: Check the measure before claiming cause and effect.

title: GPT4o is WEIRD! — WVS cultural-bias essay
one_line_claim: GPT-4o-mini's answers to WVS-style values questions cluster close to WEIRD, especially US, values.
notes: Public essay; use as a compact bridge from cultural-bias discussion to the stronger SCA evidence.
caveat: This is one model on survey-style questions, so read it as a bias signal, not a settled result.

title: Adepa / La Gaceta carta — verification and local context
one_line_claim: When AI makes generation and amplification cheap, verification and locally named context become scarce public goods.
notes: Not yet published. Evidence spike waits until published; pending civic seed is not a live Evidence-A spike.
tone_hint: Augusto-civic: English on X/LinkedIn, Spanish only for op-eds / soft Evidence if pending
caveat: Not published yet: an argument, not evidence.

title: EconLLM Lab
notes: Public lab/site asset; working-program evidence, useful lightly for research-method threads.
caveat: This describes a working research program, not a finished result.
one_line_claim: Combining games, experiments, LLM agents, and complex-systems methods is a productive way to study heterogeneous behavior.

title: Smart Surveys: An Automatic Survey Generation and Analysis Tool (CSEDU 2023)
one_line_claim: An LLM-assisted pipeline can support survey generation, collection, text mining, and reporting in research design.
notes: CSEDU 2023 paper; cite for survey-design automation rather than generic AI productivity claims.
